create_dataloader_for_trajectories: create a PyTorch DataLoader from trajectories with length-weighted sampling and state normalization
transform_trajectory_subsequences: transform a trajectory into padded and normalized state, action, reward, and RTG tensors
sample_trajectories_by_length: sample trajectory indices proportional to their lengths for length-weighted trajectory sampling
compute_discounted_cumulative_rewards: compute the discounted cumulative sum of rewards for calculating return-to-go values
create_subtrajectory_dataset: create a PyTorch Dataset that indexes into trajectories with optional transform sampling
